AI can help us build dashboards faster than ever before. But faster does not automatically mean better. In this session, Marjolein Opsteegh shares practical examples of how she works together with AI while designing Power BI dashboards. You'll see where AI can save time, generate ideas, and challenge your thinking, but also where human judgment remains essential. The focus is not on writing DAX or creating visuals more quickly. item.title: [14 Oct] Spec-Driven Development with ATDD & AI (Valentina Jemuović)
item.description:
When: Wednesday 14 October 2026, 18:30
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

You write a spec, hand it to AI, and it gives you back a PR that looks right. But the implementation can be wrong! In the current tools (Kiro, spec-kit, Tessl), the spec is a Markdown file AI is supposed to follow. But AI can ignore the spec or misread it. So you end up testing everything by hand, and QA keeps sending the PR back because it doesn't work. In this session, you'll see how to use ATDD to practice spec-driven development with executable specs. Starting from the acceptance criteria, AI writes failing acceptance tests (RED), and you review and approve them. Then AI implements the system code until the acceptance tests pass (GREEN), which shows that the acceptance criteria are met. …
